description: FragmentManager::computeAllData on a distributed mesh broken line by line (rank view)

build.cxx_flags: -ffp-contract=off -DEIGEN_DONT_VECTORIZE -DEIGEN_NO_CPUID -DEIGEN_DEFAULT_L1_CACHE_SIZE=16384 -DEIGEN_DEFAULT_L2_CACHE_SIZE=524288 -DEIGEN_DEFAULT_L3_CACHE_SIZE=524288 -O2 -g -DNDEBUG -g3 -ggdb3 -flarge-source-files -std=c++20 -flto=auto -fno-fat-lto-objects -fPIC -frounding-math (actual flags of src/model/solid_mechanics/solid_mechanics_model.cc; warnings and non-FP -D defines omitted)

libraries.eigen_cache_sizes_measured: 16384,524288,524288 (Eigen::l1/l2/l3CacheSize() read at run time in the probe process, D-050)
libraries.eigen_cache_sizes: 16384,524288,524288 (compile-time pin of the library and of the probe translation unit: EIGEN_NO_CPUID + defaults, D-050)

parameters.material_dat:
model solid_mechanics_model_cohesive [
  cohesive_inserter [
    bounding_box = [[-10, 10], [-10, 10]]
  ]
  material elastic [
    name = bulk
    rho = 1e3
    E = 1e3
    nu = 0.1
  ]
  material cohesive_linear [
    name = cohesive
    beta = 1
    G_c = 1e-3
    sigma_c = 1
  ]
]
parameters.partition/rule: 2-D rule of the probe header, xc = 0
